newsitem.title: UK: Williams firm after upbeat AGM statement.
newsitem.headline: Williams firm after upbeat AGM statement.

text.p: Shares in Williams Holdings Plc recovered from opening losses and pushed higher on Wednesday after the diversified industrial holding company said its current trading outlook was "pleasing".

By 1210 GMT the shares were up 2-1/2p to 308p following an earlier low of 304p after the company told shareholders at its annual meeting the underlying performance of it various businesses had enjoyed a good start to the year.
"The market was pleased to hear this", a trader said referring to a trading statement released at the AGM.
Williams noted, however, that the strong pound, which is currently trading at near five-year highs against major currencies, would impact on earnings growth.
